question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**hospital**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **hospital: **an institution providing medical and surgical treatment and nursing care for sick or injured people.
 
• **school: **an institution for educating children.
 
• **fire-station: **the headquarters of a fire brigade, where fire engines and other equipment are housed.
 
• **post office: **the public department or corporation responsible for postal services and (in some countries) telecommunications.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**hospital**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• In the given context, the injured boy needed medical treatment so the hospital is the correct word choice.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**The complete passage is**: A woman has been called a hero after fighting a mountain lion that ***(1) attacked*** her five-year-old son. She dragged her little ***(2) boy*** away from the big cat and beat it with ***(3) her*** fists in her garden. The boy had bites*** (4) and*** cuts to his head and body. He is now in a local*** (5) hospital***. He is expected to make a full recovery.
